activity.notes: ATLAS uses c.430 BCE as a bounded representative Athenian intellectual-activity point for Herodotus. Biographical tradition places a visit to Athens about 430 BCE during the period in which he was composing and refining the Histories. The date is explicitly approximate and is not treated as a life or authorship boundary.

sources.title: Herodotus — Encyclopaedia Britannica 1911 via Fordham Ancient History Sourcebook
sources.citation_text: The biographical entry places an indicated visit by Herodotus to Athens about 430 BCE and discusses the composition and revision of his Histories.
